notes:
High-level: mid-market product analytics vendor building an in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows) to reduce time-to-values and increase feature activation. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast time-to-value) then Dedicated for production stability/predictable throughput. Primary focus: streaming responses + tool/function calling to product APIs (create workspace, prefill settings, verify integrations).

Key constraints/asks: 
- Latency SLO: need 120-250ms tail for streaming tokens in UI; consistent streaming for first 1-2s of reply to keep perceived latency low.
- Token caps: strict session-level token budgets (typical session cap ~1,500 tokens) — must enforce/cost predictability.
- Tool calling: require robust function calling and safe fallbacks when downstream product services slow.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; want Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quantization) to hit ARR targets.
- Security: SOC2 required; prefer KMS integration for key control; audit logs and retention controls for event history.
- Residency: US primarily, potential EU region later.

Notes from calls: 
- 2026-02-18 kickoff: AE + SE demo of hosted streaming; product team emphasized UX: "First chunk within 300ms, steady streaming after".
- 2026-02-25 security review: sent questionnaire; asking for SSO/SAML flow diagram and KMS options.
- 2026-03-02 perf check-in: POC artifact created (streaming enabled); observed 180-320ms median / p95 spikes during high concurrency. SE suggested batching + prefix cache.
- Quote from PM: "We need predictable latency more than the absolute fastest model — jitter kills in-app trust."

POC goals: baseline Hosted API streaming latency at 50 concurrent sessions, validate tool calling reliability (idempotency, retries), measure token consumption per guided flow, test Optimize suggestions (1) caching welcome prompts, (2) session-level truncation to meet token caps.

Commercial: interest in switching to Dedicated once throughput and latency SLOs hit consistently; will require committed monthly capacity forecast. Pricing sensitivity around per-token spikes and reserved capacity discounts.

Next steps detailed: 1) SE-run perf tests with streaming + tool calls (3/11-3/18), 2) pricing follow-up and committed capacity scenarios (3/19), 3) security KMS integration spec from Redwood (requested by 3/22), 4) legal DPA draft review.
